raw_transcription:
Music
In the name of the cave, the women in the foot
and the time of the tunnel, we are the honest
Luca, Luca and Karen, Luca, Luca
Gallop ca-le-ves-lu-go-vèl-né-lo, Gallop ca-le-po-ca-le-po-ca ¡Aquí se le reche o Gallop ca-le-po-ca-le-po-ca!
Pémano fa pa cha-ci lextaíu,
dans la mancha saucorda la savon!
Le clansur-vito caughti di'ar dans ce monde,
qui se fane!
The stars are guiding us in the peaceful night
The time passes, we remain
Covered in the rock, our songs
And for a long time, the story of human history
We are still engraved in the foot of our song.
and go to pass the night and we'll be able to read the human story
and we'll be able to read the human story.
